name: Cryptomus Virtual Crypto Card
summary: A digital-only prepaid card funded with USDT or USDC, supporting Apple Pay and Google Pay for global online and in-store payments.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only, no physical card

faq.question: Does the Cryptomus Virtual Crypto Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$4.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Cryptomus Virtual Crypto Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 3.9% on non-base-currency spending.
